# DTPI // Dylan's Trader Joe Price Input
> Cyberpunk grocery price reference calculator and NYC store price database.

## Summary
DTPI (Dylan's Trader Joe Price Input) is a web application and searchable database tracking real-world receipt line items and prices across NYC grocery stores including Trader Joe's, Fairway, City Fresh Market, Whole Foods, Walgreens, and CVS.

## Key Information & Features
- Price Database: Indexes 500+ receipt entries with item names, store locations, dates, categories, unit prices, and UPC codes.
- Calculator: Built-in interactive total calculator for running receipt totals and cost planning.
- Store Locations: Trader Joe's (59th St #0571, 125th St #0576), Fairway (86th St #183), Whole Foods (East 57th St), City Fresh Market, Walgreens, and CVS.
